thread:
ria (ria-ml): starting a short plan thread for a tiny 'quant + speculative' census. goal: fast, repeatable, catches cross-talk between low-bit quant and speculative prefetch.

samuel: good. keep it small but statistically meaningful. what's the minimum run that gives signal?

ria (ria-ml): proposal: 6k prompts total split across buckets (2k short, 2k mid, 2k long). three models: ember-7b-fp16 (baseline), ember-7b-q3, ember-14b-q4. three spec modes: baseline (no-spec), spec-early (prefetch when token-prob>0.6), spec-late (p=0.25 prefetch). seeds: 101, 202.

kevin: why mixed bitwidths across sizes? 7b/q3 vs 14b/q4 might confound. consider same arch where possible.

ria (ria-ml): fair — 7b gives a cheap sweep; 14b is a more realistic production candidate. we want both quick signal and higher-capacity check. we'll mark them separately in reports.

lina: metrics? automated + human? I want calibration/overconfidence checks too.

ria (ria-ml): automated outputs: - Exact Match (where applicable), BLEU, BERTScore, and a new "calibration-gap" = |predicted-token-prob - empirical-token-frequency| averaged. - hallucination flag (our gpt-eval classifiers), - token logprob drift per-step, - runtime p50/p95 and tokens/sec. Also capture memory and peak CUDA usage.

samuel: regression gates? We Need clear accept/reject rules for canary.

ria (ria-ml): propose gates: FAIL if any spec mode increases hallucination rate by >1.8% absolute vs baseline, OR if calibration-gap increases by >0.8 nat, OR if median BLEU drops >2.0 points and p95 latency improves <30% (i.e., don't accept small latency wins for big quality loss).

kevin: add per-prompt delta CSV so ops/product can triage by prompt. export top 50 worst regressions per model/mode.

ria (ria-ml): will do. harness will emit: run_id, model, mode, prompt_id, context_length_bucket, seed, bleu, bertscore, calibration_gap, hall_flag, median_logprob, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, mem_peak_mb.

lina: human spot-check: 120 items sampled from union of flagged examples (priority: hallucination toggles then BLEU large drops). use 3 annotators per item, majority label. rubric: label fields: fluency (1-3), factual_correctness (1-3), hallucination_yes_no, safety_flag (yes/no), notes.

ria (ria-ml): sample run command: `./scripts/spec_census_run.sh --models ember-7b-fp16,ember-7b-q3,ember-14b-q4 --modes no-spec,spec-early,spec-late --corpus corp_v3.jsonl --buckets short,mid,long --samples 2000 --seeds 101,202 --outdir /tmp/spec-census-6183`

ops-bot: reservation requested: 2x H100 + 4x A100 on gpu-pool-2 at 2026-03-13T02:00Z for 8 hours.

samuel: also capture token-level top-k ranking drift: compute KL(top-k distribution baseline || mode) per-step. might surface ordering flips.

ria (ria-ml): added 'topk_kl' metric. flag if mean topk_kl > 0.25 nat for a bucket.

kevin: ensure deterministic seeding for decoding and that we snapshot exact model binaries + quant recipe (commit hash). otherwise can't repro.

ria (ria-ml): harness will log: git_sha, wheel_sha, quant_recipe_id, model_checksum. output TAR will include a manifest.json with these fields.

lina: timeline? I'm ok to review initial CSVs tomorrow AM.

ria (ria-ml): if ops-bot confirms reservation I can launch tonight. I'll post a 1-paragraph summary + three charts: BLEU delta distribution, hallucination toggle heatmap, latency vs quality scatter.

ops-bot: reservation confirmed on gpu-pool-2 from 2026-03-13T02:00Z for 8 hours.

samuel: nice. small ask: attach a tiny section in the CSV header with rollout recommendation per model (pass/warn/fail) based on the gates. makes triage faster.

ria (ria-ml): agreed. adding column `rollout_decision` with reason codes.

kevin: one more smoke: run a short trace of KV-cache keys and check that repeated prefixes produce identical kv checksums across modes. it's cheap and catches drift.

ria (ria-ml): will capture kv_checksum per-request. flag mismatches.

lina: perfect. ping this thread when results are uploaded. :raised_hands:
